name: Magic: The Gathering API
tagline: Community MTG card catalog with sets, types, and multiverse IDs
description: Scrydex's current Magic: The Gathering API is a paid, API-key service for card metadata and Lucene-like search, including types, subtypes, supertypes, mana costs, rules, images, expansion data, and opt-in pricing. MTG price-history and webhook endpoints are also documented.

auth.details: No authentication required; public endpoints accept unauthenticated HTTP requests.

pricing.free_tier_limits: No published free plan. Starter is $29/month with 5,000 API credits; overage is $0.006 per credit. Unauthenticated requests may proceed only at heavily reduced limits.

rate_limits: 100 requests/second for all plans, plus plan-based API-credit allowances. Most standard requests cost 1 credit; usage beyond included credits incurs plan-specific overage charges.
use_cases: look up MTG card details by name or multiverse ID
list cards in a specific set by set code
fetch legal card types, subtypes, and supertypes
search cards by color, rarity, or mana cost filters
get MTG set metadata and release information
